definitions.explanation: A journey that covers a long distance or takes a long time. Often used in welcoming someone who has just arrived from far away.

examples.japanese: {長旅|ながたび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: To set off on a long journey.

examples.japanese: {長旅|ながたび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm tired from the long trip.

examples.japanese: {長旅|ながたび}お{疲|つか}れさまでした。⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: You must be tired after your long journey. Please have a good rest tonight.

notes:
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) + ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (journey).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長旅|ながたび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to set off on a long journey
- {長旅|ながたび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧: the fatigue of a long journey
- {長旅|ながたび}お{疲|つか}れさまでした: welcome, you must be tired from your long trip (said to someone arriving)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: journey — the base word, with a literary feel
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: trip, travel — the everyday word, not used for this greeting
